name: Gigwa MCP Server
description: Drive a Gigwa genotyping server: import, server-side variant search, QC and diversity analyses.
author: Anestis Gkanogiannis

skills.name: Gigwa Import and QC Workflow
skills.description: Guides agent through importing DArTseq/VCF files, running QC benchmarks, and evaluating pipeline health.

skills.name: Gigwa Diversity Report Analyzer
skills.description: Orchestrates multi-step population genetics metrics like PCA profiling, kinship matrices, and UPGMA trees.

skills.name: Gigwa QC Triage Assistant
skills.description: Executes full quality control sequences on imported genomic sets to deliver clean triage verdicts.

skills.name: Gigwa Instance Explorer
skills.description: Conducts a top-to-bottom instance health audit and catalogues overall content topology.

skills.name: Gigwa Local Region Scanner
skills.description: Investigates genomic variant density and isolates micro-diversity patterns inside specific windows.
